subject.declared_domain: The ontology rail between C1 and C2: a composed DIRECTED TYPED PATH -- the ordered hops a value takes, each hop's EdgeKind transform, and the CADENCE the path is contracted to run at. A motif is a shape; a path is a shape WITH direction, transform and time. This card covers the rail's definition and the graph surfaces it composes over, not the C1 or C2 rungs.

methodology.how: The rail is HAND-AUTHORED in the ontology rule bank. It takes the existing C2 motif topology ('typed multi-hop paths @ recurrence') and adds three axes the topology does not carry: DIRECTION (native, CloudEdge is a -> b), TRANSFORM (the hop's D1 EdgeKind) and TIME (cadence, sourced from D3). It does not re-implement motif membership.

coverage.universe: Directed typed paths over the graph's flow and control edges -- the transitive closure over produces/consumes/FLOWS_TO, with a transform at each hop and a cadence contracted from D3.
coverage.denominator_absent_reason: THERE IS NO PATH POPULATION TO COUNT. A path is a transitive closure computed at query time, not a stored object, so the universe has no enumerable membership and no denominator can be stated without first fixing a start set, a depth bound and an edge-type filter -- none of which the rail declares. What CAN be counted is the EDGE population the closure runs over, and the rail states it: flow edges FLOWS_TO 961, WRITES 562, READS 712, WRITES_S3 275, READS_S3 323, EMITS_TO 144, FETCHES 109, PUBLISHES_TO 36; control edges RUNS 248, TRIGGERS 145, INVOKES 41; cadence nodes EVENT_RULE 141, EVENT_SOURCE 95, SCHEDULE 10, STATE_MACHINE 1. Those are edge counts at as_of 2026-07-23, not path counts, and reporting them as a path denominator would be a grain error.
explicitly_out: CADENCE as a graph primitive -- it is D3-sourced and forward where undeclared, BY DESIGN: freshness is downstream of flow plus contract, not an artifact property.
upstream VINTAGE (when a value last actually moved) -- a RUN-TIME live probe of the artifact, never the static graph. A D2 path types WHERE to look; the vintage read stays live.
cross-plane hops (aws -> portal via FETCHES/PROJECTS_TO) -- these often carry no typed transform, because EdgeKind lives on FLOWS_TO. Forward for cross-plane transform semantics.

The edge counts quoted in denominator_absent_reason are the rail's OWN graph_evidence values at as_of 2026-07-23 and are HELD, not re-measured here -- and the rail itself records that 6 of 11 of them had drifted from live by 2026-08-20, which is the strongest available reason not to restate them as current.

key.identity_space: The rail's central object is a PATH. Paths have no identity space in the graph: they are computed, not stored. The spaces that DO exist and that a path is assembled from are (a) CloudNode ids for the endpoints and (b) graph edge_type literals for the hops.
key.declared_mapping: None for paths, because there is nothing to map to. For the constituent hops, the edge_type literal is the key and D1_value_grain's card carries the expression that yields it. A consumer that needs a stable handle on a path must MINT one (a digest over the ordered hop list at a declared grain and depth bound) and no such minting rule is declared anywhere in the rail.
key.evidence: key_expression is NULL and its basis is ABSENT -- STRUCTURAL PAYLOAD ABSENCE, not an unanswered question, and it is MEASURED as absent rather than assumed. The subject states it directly at @5fc45ad69d: path_is.direction reads 'NATIVE -- CloudEdge is directed (a -> b). A path is the transitive closure over produces/consumes/FLOWS_TO.' A transitive closure is computed per query and has no stored identity. I then checked the ratified vocabulary for a materialized path node type: flattening `node_bindings` yields 71 node tokens, of which ZERO contain 'PATH'. POSITIVE CONTROL, run because an empty result over the wrong corpus reads identically to a true absence: the same collection returns S3_BUCKET, S3Key and S3_BUCKET_POLICY, so the instrument demonstrably sees node types when they exist. (A first attempt searched the top level of `node_bindings`, whose keys are ROLES -- Store, Registry, Gateway -- not node types; its positive control returned no S3 token either, which is how the wrong-plane search was caught before it became this row's evidence.) So: no expression can yield a path's key because a path has no key, and that is the honest answer this field exists to force.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: A path walk over an incomplete edge set returns a SHORTER PATH, not an error -- and a shorter path is a well-formed answer. The consumer sees a provenance chain that terminates early, or a blast radius that stops short, with nothing indicating the walk ran out of typed edges rather than reaching a true origin or leaf. Because cadence is forward where undeclared, a freshness derivation over such a path silently substitutes 'no contract' for 'no obligation' and returns a verdict computed on a path that is not contracted to run at all.
silent_degrade_paths: A cross-plane hop with no typed transform (aws -> portal via FETCHES/PROJECTS_TO) breaks the transform chain mid-path; the walk continues and the transform semantics are simply missing for that hop, not flagged.

An undeclared cadence renders as 'forward', so a freshness derivation returns a value rather than refusing -- the rail declares this as BY DESIGN, which makes it a known silent path rather than a bug.
The edge counts are frozen at 2026-07-23 with 6 of 11 known to have drifted by 2026-08-20; a walk sized against them is sized against a stale population.
A path that is genuinely absent and a path whose edges are unmapped both return an empty walk.
failure_mode.evidence: Every degrade path is stated by the SUBJECT at @5fc45ad69d: coverage_boundary item 3 names the untyped cross-plane transform; path_is.cadence.forward_where_undeclared is TRUE and its note names the D3 dependency; graph_evidence.as_of names the freeze AND the 6-of-11 drift. 'distinguishable_from_true_negative: no' follows from the first fact rather than from caution: a truncated walk and a complete walk have the same shape and the same type, so no consumer-visible field separates them.

verdict.why: The rail's definition, composition and boundaries are measured at a stated vintage, and the three things it adds to the C2 topology (direction, transform, time) are each grounded in a named source. It is QUALIFIED and not SOUND for one structural reason and one vintage reason. STRUCTURAL: the rail's central object has NO IDENTITY -- a path is a computed closure, key_expression is null with basis absent, and no minting rule is declared, so two consumers cannot agree on which path they are discussing without inventing a handle. VINTAGE: every count is frozen at 2026-07-23 and the rail itself records 6 of 11 as drifted, so the coverage row is held. Neither is a defect in the rail's design; both are things a consumer must be told before building on it, which is what this card is for.

forward_disposition.evidence: D2 is the composition point for three named derivations (freshness, staleness-vs-frozen, provenance-walked-backward) and is referenced by D3's derivations_licensed. Deprecating it would strand those.
